payload.reason: The evidence provides specific datasets used for evaluation in various tasks, including neural machine translation and image captioning.

claims.text: For neural machine translation, the datasets used include WMT 2014 for English-to-German (En-De) with around 4.5 million sentence pairs, IWSLT 2015 for English-to-Vietnamese (En-Vi) with around 133K sentence pairs, and IWSLT 2014 for German-to-English (De-En).
For image captioning, the Microsoft COCO 2014 dataset was used, which contains 123,287 images with 5 descriptive sentences each.
The tst2012 dataset was used for validation and tst2013 for testing in the evaluation of the translation tasks.
